summary: Steele Bancorp Inc. filed an 8-K on May 21, 2026, announcing a regular semi-annual cash dividend of $0.76 per share, payable June 29, 2026, to shareholders of record June 15, 2026. The dividend is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, strategic review, or other corporate event is involved. The filing simply discloses a board-declared dividend with no unusual terms, premiums, or structural changes. This is a standard current report for dividend declaration, warranting no special-situation classification.
